ability.mr.golem.l5.2.Effect: May inflict Knockback by weapon blow at will; costs 6 TBLP per blow if +2 Strength or greater, otherwise 9 TBLP.

ability.mr.golem.l5.3.Name: Ice Major Power
ability.mr.golem.l5.3.Effect: May inflict Snowball-equivalent touch damage (12/12 magical cold) at will for 6 TBLP per touch.

ability.mr.golem.l5.4.Name: Bronze Major Power
ability.mr.golem.l5.4.Effect: Immunity to Bruising and may round damage fractions down rather than up.

ability.mr.golem.l6.2.Name: Extreme Mass
ability.mr.golem.l6.2.Effect: Now requires 5 grades of strength to move physically when dead, unconscious, or helpless.

ability.mr.golem.l6.3.Name: No Physical Jump
ability.mr.golem.l6.3.Effect: May not use physical Jump abilities.

ability.mr.great-ogre.l1.Name: Food-Bound Loyalty
ability.mr.great-ogre.l1.Effect: Perceives those who provide food as friends unless they attack the Ogre or tribe members.

ability.mr.great-ogre.l1.2.Name: +6/2 Life
ability.mr.great-ogre.l1.2.Effect: +6 TBLP and +2 loc life (stacking with published life abilities unless otherwise specified).

ability.mr.great-ogre.l3.Name: Immunity to Domination
ability.mr.great-ogre.l3.Effect: Gains immunity to all domination effects.

ability.mr.high-elf.l1.Name: Half-Spirit Ascension
ability.mr.high-elf.l1.Effect: Now has a half-spirit as Half-Elf, is no longer injured by Dispels, and remains immune to Flesh and Blood effects as applicable to elves.

ability.mr.high-elf.l1.2.Name: Half-Elf Immunity Upgrade
ability.mr.high-elf.l1.2.Effect: Half Elves taking this option become immune to Flesh and Blood effects to elf extent.

ability.mr.high-elf.l3.Name: Rebirth at 8th
ability.mr.high-elf.l3.Effect: Gains Rebirth at 8th level (must already have bought Rebirth).

ability.mr.high-elf.l5.Name: Rebirth with One-Third Points
ability.mr.high-elf.l5.Effect: May Rebirth at 8th keeping one-third original points; must purchase High Elf first when rebirthing.

ability.mr.high-elf.l6.Name: Human Life for Full Elves
ability.mr.high-elf.l6.Effect: Characters who were full elves now have human life of same base class.

ability.mr.high-elf.l6.2.Name: Half-Elf Buy-as Upgrade
ability.mr.high-elf.l6.2.Effect: Those who were Half Elves may now buy as full elf of their type.

ability.mr.high-elf.l6.3.Name: Mantic Elven Innates
ability.mr.high-elf.l6.3.Effect: All elven handbook innates become mantic (e.g. affirms grant SAC additionally).

ability.mr.hobgoblin.l1.Name: Half-Orc Life Scale
ability.mr.hobgoblin.l1.Effect: Base life from this race equals that of a Half-Orc of equal multi-race level; if resulting base class life exceeds 48 this does increase base life for capping calculations.

ability.mr.hobgoblin.l2.Name: Human Armour Permissions
ability.mr.hobgoblin.l2.Effect: May wear any armour permitted for a Human of same class (no change for Shaman/Witch Doctor).

ability.mr.hobgoblin.l3.Name: +1 PAC and Weapon Access
ability.mr.hobgoblin.l3.Effect: +1 PAC, gains B skill, loses Goblin weapon restrictions; if E-skill acquired it may be used with any usable weapon.

ability.mr.hobgoblin.l4.Name: Backstab Conversion
ability.mr.hobgoblin.l4.Effect: Loses Goblin racial Backstab skill and now inflicts +6 base damage on blows where Backstab would normally be usable.

ability.mr.hobgoblin.l5.2.Name: Insensitive Skin
ability.mr.hobgoblin.l5.2.Effect: Now has Insensitive Skin as tables ability.

ability.mr.hobgoblin.l6.Name: Taunt
ability.mr.hobgoblin.l6.Effect: After 30s verbal taunt and while continuing to taunt, takes only 1 point per grade from target blows (Rockskin style) up to 5 minutes.

ability.mr.immortal.l1.Name: Scaling Physical Reduction
ability.mr.immortal.l1.Effect: Suffers one-sixth less damage from physical attacks per level of this race (at 6th is immune to physical damage).

ability.mr.immortal.l1.2.Name: Flesh and Blood Immunity
ability.mr.immortal.l1.2.Effect: Immunity to Flesh and Blood effects (including potions, poisons, and pain).

ability.mr.immortal.l2.Name: Immortal Defence
ability.mr.immortal.l2.Effect: Gains one-quarter off all damage with a physical component for five minutes.

ability.mr.immortal.l3.2.Name: Half Beneficial Physical Effect
ability.mr.immortal.l3.2.Effect: Now only receives half effect from beneficial physical effects.

ability.mr.immortal.l4.Name: Empowered Defence
ability.mr.immortal.l4.Effect: Upgrades an Immortal Defence so it grants one-third off damage.

ability.mr.immortal.l5.Name: Form of the Immortal
ability.mr.immortal.l5.Effect: Grants complete immunity to physical effects for 5 minutes.

ability.mr.immortal.l6.Name: Immortal Armour
ability.mr.immortal.l6.Effect: Upgrades an Empowered Defence to a Rockskin-style reduction vs all damage with a physical component.

ability.mr.mind-over-reality.l1.Name: Scaling Non-Physical/Non-Neuronic Reduction
ability.mr.mind-over-reality.l1.Effect: Gains one-sixth off all damage except Physical and Neuronic per level.

ability.mr.mind-over-reality.l1.2.Name: Neuronic Bracket Lock
ability.mr.mind-over-reality.l1.2.Effect: May never leave or buy-as outside the neuronic bracket.

ability.mr.mind-over-reality.l1.3.Name: No Mind-Bar/Neuronic Immunity
ability.mr.mind-over-reality.l1.3.Effect: May never Mind-Bar or become immune to neuronics.

ability.mr.mind-over-reality.l1.4.Name: Neural Foci Requirement (2 per level)
ability.mr.mind-over-reality.l1.4.Effect: Must have at least 2 permanent neural foci per level of this race.

ability.mr.mind-over-reality.l2.Name: Reality Controlled
ability.mr.mind-over-reality.l2.Effect: Gain complete immunity to Magic or Spirit for 5 minutes.

ability.mr.mind-over-reality.l3.Name: Kill/Sever Restriction
ability.mr.mind-over-reality.l3.Effect: Can only be killed or have a location severed by Physical or Neuronic means.

ability.mr.mind-over-reality.l3.2.Name: Neural Foci Requirement (3 per level)
ability.mr.mind-over-reality.l3.2.Effect: Now requires at least 3 permanent neural foci per level of this race.

ability.mr.mind-over-reality.l3.3.Name: Beneficial Effect Immunity
ability.mr.mind-over-reality.l3.3.Effect: Gains immunity to beneficial effects that are not Neuronic or Physical in nature.

ability.mr.mind-over-reality.l4.Name: Disperse Mind
ability.mr.mind-over-reality.l4.Effect: Acts as gaseous form except the user is only harmed by neuronics rather than miracles.

ability.mr.mind-over-reality.l5.Name: Forced Reality
ability.mr.mind-over-reality.l5.Effect: First time needed each day gains a stacking Live to Minus 6 that is neuronic-only.

ability.mr.mind-over-reality.l6.Name: Alter Reality
ability.mr.mind-over-reality.l6.Effect: Counts as Purity of Mind vs one just-suffered effect (declare within 2 seconds); costs a level to use.

ability.mr.mind-over-reality.l6.2.Name: Neural Foci Requirement (4 per level)
ability.mr.mind-over-reality.l6.2.Effect: Must now have 4 permanent neural foci per level of this race.

ability.mr.ogre-magi.l1.Name: Greater Cunning
ability.mr.ogre-magi.l1.Effect: General intelligence rises to roughly Half-Orc warrior level.

ability.mr.ogre-magi.l1.2.Name: Recognise Mana and Verbal Adaptation
ability.mr.ogre-magi.l1.2.Effect: Gains Recognise Mana at will and may adapt spell verbals like a shaman/witch-doctor as appropriate.

ability.mr.ogre-magi.l1.3.Name: Blue Woad Markings
ability.mr.ogre-magi.l1.3.Effect: Must incorporate blue woad-like markings in makeup.

ability.mr.ogre-magi.l2.Name: Puff of Air
ability.mr.ogre-magi.l2.Effect: Puff of Air at will for 1 TBLP per use.

ability.mr.ogre-magi.l6.2.Name: Immunity to Electrical Attacks
ability.mr.ogre-magi.l6.2.Effect: Now completely immune to all electrical attacks.

ability.mr.primal-soul.l1.Name: Select Primal Tree
ability.mr.primal-soul.l1.Effect: Choose Primal Bound, Predator, or Prey as the character’s primal tree.

ability.mr.primal-soul.l1.2.Name: Primal Markings
ability.mr.primal-soul.l1.2.Effect: For any choice other than Primal Bound, makeup/costume must be reminiscent of the chosen creature type.

ability.mr.primal-soul.l2.Name: Primal Bound Minor Talent
ability.mr.primal-soul.l2.Effect: Choose one Minor talent from Primal Bound.

ability.mr.primal-soul.l2.2.Name: Predator Minor Talent
ability.mr.primal-soul.l2.2.Effect: Choose one Minor talent from Predator.

ability.mr.primal-soul.l2.3.Name: Prey Minor Talent
ability.mr.primal-soul.l2.3.Effect: Choose one Minor talent from Prey.

ability.mr.primal-soul.l4.Name: Primal Bound Medium Talent
ability.mr.primal-soul.l4.Effect: Choose one Medium talent from Primal Bound.

ability.mr.primal-soul.l4.2.Name: Predator Medium Talent
ability.mr.primal-soul.l4.2.Effect: Choose one Medium talent from Predator.

ability.mr.primal-soul.l4.3.Name: Prey Medium Talent
ability.mr.primal-soul.l4.3.Effect: Choose one Medium talent from Prey.

ability.mr.primal-soul.l5.Name: Discern Own Kind
ability.mr.primal-soul.l5.Effect: At will by sight, physically discern creatures of the exact chosen race (yes/no with ref-discretion detail).

ability.mr.primal-soul.l6.Name: Primal Bound Major Talent
ability.mr.primal-soul.l6.Effect: Choose one Major talent from Primal Bound.

ability.mr.primal-soul.l6.2.Name: Predator Major Talent
ability.mr.primal-soul.l6.2.Effect: Choose one Major talent from Predator.

ability.mr.primal-soul.l6.3.Name: Prey Major Talent
ability.mr.primal-soul.l6.3.Effect: Choose one Major talent from Prey.

ability.mr.rock-troll.l1.Name: Flesh and Blood Immunity
ability.mr.rock-troll.l1.Effect: Now immune to Flesh and Blood effects including ingestion (no potion effects).

ability.mr.rock-troll.l1.2.Name: Rocky Makeup
ability.mr.rock-troll.l1.2.Effect: Must incorporate stone and rocky complexion into makeup.

ability.mr.rock-troll.l2.2.Name: Live to Minus Scaling
ability.mr.rock-troll.l2.2.Effect: Gains additional Live to Minus 3 per level of this multi-race, stacking with all other published live-to-minus.

ability.mr.rock-troll.l2.3.Name: Regeneration Base Boost
ability.mr.rock-troll.l2.3.Effect: Regeneration now heals base 1 TBLP and 1 to every injured location per 5 minutes.

ability.mr.rock-troll.l4.2.Name: Regeneration Rate Increase
ability.mr.rock-troll.l4.2.Effect: Regeneration now heals base 2 TBLP and 2 to each injured location per 5 minutes (a +1x rate increase).

ability.mr.rock-troll.l5.2.Name: Rockskin vs Stone Weapons
ability.mr.rock-troll.l5.2.Effect: Stone weapons inflict damage as if user were under Rockskin at all times; innate PAC may always apply to physical-component weapon blows.

ability.mr.rock-troll.l6.2.Name: Regeneration Class Enhancements
ability.mr.rock-troll.l6.2.Effect: Warriors may heal permanent damage by natural regen except fire/spirit; shamans may heal spirit damage by regen; witches may heal fire damage by regen.

ability.mr.servant-of-the-spirits.l1.Name: Flesh and Blood Immunity
ability.mr.servant-of-the-spirits.l1.Effect: Now immune to all Flesh and Blood effects (including potions and pain).

ability.mr.servant-of-the-spirits.l1.2.Name: Neutral Supernatural Creature
ability.mr.servant-of-the-spirits.l1.2.Effect: Counts as a Supernatural Neutral Creature From Another Plane.

ability.mr.servant-of-the-spirits.l1.3.Name: Runic Markings
ability.mr.servant-of-the-spirits.l1.3.Effect: Requires silvery/grey swirls and/or runic markings over exposed skin.

ability.mr.servant-of-the-spirits.l2.Name: Touch Psi-Scan
ability.mr.servant-of-the-spirits.l2.Effect: Touch reads surface thoughts as spiritual Psi-Scan at will for 1 TBLP.

ability.mr.servant-of-the-spirits.l2.2.Name: Detect Spirits Nature
ability.mr.servant-of-the-spirits.l2.2.Effect: Detect Spirits Nature at will using full verbals as normal.

ability.mr.servant-of-the-spirits.l3.Name: Detect Lie
ability.mr.servant-of-the-spirits.l3.Effect: Detect Lie at will for 3 TBLP using full handbook verbals.

ability.mr.servant-of-the-spirits.l4.Name: Insight of the Spirits
ability.mr.servant-of-the-spirits.l4.Effect: After 30s concentration, gain ability to cast one published neutral miracle for the rest of dungeon (must be normally learnable).

ability.mr.servant-of-the-spirits.l6.Name: Permanent Active Spirit Sight
ability.mr.servant-of-the-spirits.l6.Effect: Gains permanent fully active Spirit Sight, revealing spirit size and alignment.

ability.mr.shadow-daimon.l1.Name: Dark Makeup Requirement
ability.mr.shadow-daimon.l1.Effect: Must wear dark/black makeup covering at least half exposed skin.

ability.mr.shadow-daimon.l1.2.Name: Extinguish (10ft)
ability.mr.shadow-daimon.l1.2.Effect: May Extinguish lights within 10ft at will with full cantrip verbal.

ability.mr.shadow-daimon.l1.3.Name: Permanent Mantic Ally Darkness
ability.mr.shadow-daimon.l1.3.Effect: Permanent mantic Ally Darkness (without granting ability to see through darkness). Counts as Daemonkind.

ability.mr.shadow-daimon.l2.Name: Shadowmeld
ability.mr.shadow-daimon.l2.Effect: Shadowmeld as per Chameleon(s) when not within 5ft of light source and not in direct daylight/supernatural light.

ability.mr.shadow-daimon.l2.2.Name: Supernatural Darkness Sight Prerequisite
ability.mr.shadow-daimon.l2.2.Effect: Must purchase “See Through Supernatural Darkness at all times” before this level.

ability.mr.shadow-daimon.l4.Name: Mantic Shadowblade
ability.mr.shadow-daimon.l4.Effect: Mantic Shadowblade x1/3 levels; mantic damage as specified by wielder eligibility.

ability.mr.shadow-daimon.l5.Name: Cloak of Darkness
ability.mr.shadow-daimon.l5.Effect: As Invisibility but cannot be used under Shadowmeld-light restrictions; ends within 5ft of any light source.

ability.mr.snaga-hai.l1.Name: Mobile Ally Darkness
ability.mr.snaga-hai.l1.Effect: Always counts as benefiting from black Ally Darkness; Darkness(r) targeted on user moves with them.

ability.mr.snaga-hai.l1.2.Name: Supernatural Darkness Sight
ability.mr.snaga-hai.l1.2.Effect: May now see through all forms of supernatural darkness.

ability.mr.snaga-hai.l1.3.Name: Shadow Woad Makeup
ability.mr.snaga-hai.l1.3.Effect: Must incorporate black shadow/woad into makeup.

ability.mr.snaga-hai.l3.Name: Unassisted Climb
ability.mr.snaga-hai.l3.Effect: Assisted climbs require only two points of contact, can continue while climbing and at full climbing speed.

ability.mr.snaga-hai.l3.2.Name: +1 Stacking Backstab
ability.mr.snaga-hai.l3.2.Effect: +1 stacking Backstab skill (stacks only with published Backstab).

ability.mr.snaga-hai.l5.Name: Bladelick
ability.mr.snaga-hai.l5.Effect: After licking a physical edged weapon, next blow within 5 minutes inflicts physical Disease as Cause Disease.

ability.mr.snaga-hai.l6.Name: Sense Motion
ability.mr.snaga-hai.l6.Effect: Now has Sense Motion except in direct daylight or magical light; requires Perception and Supernatural Perception to use.

ability.mr.spiritual-vessel.l1.Name: Scaling Non-Spirit Reduction
ability.mr.spiritual-vessel.l1.Effect: One-sixth off all damage except Spirit per level.

ability.mr.spiritual-vessel.l1.2.Name: Flesh and Blood Immunity
ability.mr.spiritual-vessel.l1.2.Effect: Immunity to Flesh and Blood effects (including potions and poison).

ability.mr.spiritual-vessel.l1.3.Name: Priest Bracket Lock
ability.mr.spiritual-vessel.l1.3.Effect: May never leave the priest bracket.

ability.mr.spiritual-vessel.l3.Name: Kill/Sever Restriction
ability.mr.spiritual-vessel.l3.Effect: Can only be killed or have a location severed by spiritual means.

ability.mr.spiritual-vessel.l3.2.Name: Beneficial Non-Spiritual Immunity
ability.mr.spiritual-vessel.l3.2.Effect: Gains immunity to beneficial effects that are not spiritual.

ability.mr.spiritual-vessel.l3.3.Name: No Spiritual Invisibility Immunity
ability.mr.spiritual-vessel.l3.3.Effect: May no longer cast Spiritual Invisibility or otherwise become immune to Spirit.

ability.mr.spiritual-vessel.l4.Name: Non-Damaging Non-Spiritual Immunity
ability.mr.spiritual-vessel.l4.Effect: Immune to non-damaging effects that are not spiritual in nature.

ability.mr.spiritual-vessel.l5.Name: Unconscious/Location Stop Restriction
ability.mr.spiritual-vessel.l5.Effect: Can only be knocked unconscious or have locations stop through spiritual means.

ability.mr.spiritual-vessel.l6.Name: Immune to All but Spirit
ability.mr.spiritual-vessel.l6.Effect: Now completely immune to all except spirits.

ability.mr.titan.l1.Name: Immunity to Pain
ability.mr.titan.l1.Effect: Immunity to pain in all forms.

ability.mr.titan.l2.2.Name: Form of the Titan
ability.mr.titan.l2.2.Effect: Grants +36/12 temporary life for 5 minutes; does not stack with supernatural temp life but does with physical temp life.

ability.mr.titan.l3.Name: 1/6 off Weapon Blows
ability.mr.titan.l3.Effect: One-sixth off weapon blows; stacks with Battle-Master interactions as listed.

ability.mr.titan.l4.2.Name: Titan’s Strength
ability.mr.titan.l4.2.Effect: May remain conscious in live to minus while in combat for 5 minutes (if live-to-minus is owned).

ability.mr.titan.l5.Name: Immunity to Supernatural Ageing
ability.mr.titan.l5.Effect: Gains immunity to supernatural ageing effects.

ability.mr.titan.l5.2.Name: 1/4 off Weapon Blows
ability.mr.titan.l5.2.Effect: Now one-quarter off weapon blows (from one-sixth), with Greater Blade Fury and Eye for an Opponent interactions as listed.

ability.mr.titan.l6.2.Name: Titan’s Endurance
ability.mr.titan.l6.2.Effect: Locations continue to function until severed while in combat; lasts 5 minutes.

ability.mr.undead.l1.Name: Select Undead Type
ability.mr.undead.l1.Effect: Select undead type: Ghoul, Mummy, Wight, Wraith, or Vampire.

ability.mr.undead.l1.2.Name: L1 Lesser Type Unknown
ability.mr.undead.l1.2.Effect: Discerns as level 1 Type Unknown undead (dismiss name Lesser XXX).

ability.mr.undead.l1.3.Name: Undead Immunity Package (L1)
ability.mr.undead.l1.3.Effect: Immune to Repel/Attract Life, Restore/Animate Life, and Discern Nature of Wounds.

ability.mr.undead.l2.2.Name: Undead Immunity Package (L2)
ability.mr.undead.l2.2.Effect: Immune to Ebony Pain, Words of Pain, all forms of Disease, and Adrenal Surge.

ability.mr.undead.l2.3.Name: Tree Purchase Access (Tier 1)
ability.mr.undead.l2.3.Effect: May buy 1st innate from chosen undead tree and the appropriate curing ability.

ability.mr.undead.l3.2.Name: Undead Immunity Package (L3)
ability.mr.undead.l3.2.Effect: Immune to Stunning Blow, Vicious Strike, Ageing, and Flesh and Blood effects.

ability.mr.undead.l3.3.Name: Tree Purchase Access (Tier 2)
ability.mr.undead.l3.3.Effect: May buy 2nd innate from chosen undead tree.

ability.mr.undead.l4.2.Name: Undead Immunity Package (L4)
ability.mr.undead.l4.2.Effect: Immune to Repel/Attract Edible and Empathic Healing.

ability.mr.undead.l4.3.Name: Tree Purchase Access (Tier 3)
ability.mr.undead.l4.3.Effect: May buy 3rd innate from chosen undead tree.

ability.mr.undead.l5.2.Name: Undead Immunity Package (L5)
ability.mr.undead.l5.2.Effect: Immune to Neuronics and physical Sleep.

ability.mr.undead.l5.3.Name: Tree Purchase Access (Tier 4)
ability.mr.undead.l5.3.Effect: May buy 4th innate from chosen undead tree if available.

ability.mr.undead.l6.2.Name: Undead Immunity Package (L6)
ability.mr.undead.l6.2.Effect: Immune to all miracles not listed as affecting undead.

ability.mr.undead.l6.3.Name: Post-6th Undead Purchases
ability.mr.undead.l6.3.Effect: May buy: Dismiss level 7, Immunity to Dismiss miracles, and Immunity to Undead Destruction effects as listed.

ability.mr.uruk-hai.l1.2.Name: Supernatural Darkness Sight
ability.mr.uruk-hai.l1.2.Effect: May now see through all forms of supernatural darkness at all times.

ability.mr.uruk-hai.l2.3.Name: Slow-Burn Detrimental Progression
ability.mr.uruk-hai.l2.3.Effect: Detrimental duration-based penalties (e.g. Disease, Words of Pain) take twice as long to affect.

ability.mr.uruk-hai.l3.2.Name: No Light DAC Penalty
ability.mr.uruk-hai.l3.2.Effect: No longer suffers DAC penalties in light.

ability.mr.uruk-hai.l5.2.Name: Strength Floor +1
ability.mr.uruk-hai.l5.2.Effect: May never be reduced below +1 strength (requires at least +1 strength to benefit).

ability.mr.uruk-hai.l6.3.Name: Black Fury
ability.mr.uruk-hai.l6.3.Effect: 50% Berserk Rage that also grants immunity to listed stopping effects for 5 minutes.

ability.mr.vessel-of-the-dead.l1.Name: Untainted Raising
ability.mr.vessel-of-the-dead.l1.Effect: If raised as undead, user is not tainted and retains own personality.

ability.mr.vessel-of-the-dead.l2.Name: Twist the Form
ability.mr.vessel-of-the-dead.l2.Effect: May be target of published raise-undead miracle on self to become that undead for 15 minutes or until slain/dismissed, with listed consequences.

ability.mr.vessel-of-the-dead.l3.Name: Death’s Form
ability.mr.vessel-of-the-dead.l3.Effect: Acts as Incarna Mortis on self only; does not suffer normal kick-out.

ability.mr.vessel-of-the-dead.l4.Name: Vessel Armour and Strength Transfer
ability.mr.vessel-of-the-dead.l4.Effect: Undead raised into the vessel may benefit from vessel physical armour and strength grades.

ability.mr.vessel-of-the-dead.l5.Name: Reactive Death’s Form
ability.mr.vessel-of-the-dead.l5.Effect: Death’s Form may now be used in response to an attack (within 2 seconds), applying only to that single attack.

ability.mr.vessel-of-the-dead.l6.Name: Animate as Zombie While Alive
ability.mr.vessel-of-the-dead.l6.Effect: Can now be animated as a zombie (as Twist the Form) while alive once per hour.

ability.mr.vessel-of-the-dragons.l1.Name: Scaling Non-Magic Reduction
ability.mr.vessel-of-the-dragons.l1.Effect: One-sixth off all damage except Magic per level.

ability.mr.vessel-of-the-dragons.l1.2.Name: Flesh and Blood Immunity
ability.mr.vessel-of-the-dragons.l1.2.Effect: Immunity to Flesh and Blood effects (including potions, poison, and pain).

ability.mr.vessel-of-the-dragons.l3.Name: Kill/Sever Restriction
ability.mr.vessel-of-the-dragons.l3.Effect: Can only be killed or have a location severed by magical means.

ability.mr.vessel-of-the-dragons.l3.2.Name: Dispel Vulnerability Rule
ability.mr.vessel-of-the-dragons.l3.2.Effect: Is now harmed by Dispels as an Elf; may no longer cast Mana Shield or otherwise become immune to magic (doing so causes death).

ability.mr.vessel-of-the-dragons.l3.3.Name: Beneficial Non-Magical Immunity
ability.mr.vessel-of-the-dragons.l3.3.Effect: Gains immunity to beneficial effects that are not magical in nature.

ability.mr.vessel-of-the-dragons.l4.Name: Non-Damaging Non-Magical Immunity
ability.mr.vessel-of-the-dragons.l4.Effect: Immune to non-damaging effects that are not magical in nature.

ability.mr.vessel-of-the-dragons.l5.Name: Unconscious/Location Stop Restriction
ability.mr.vessel-of-the-dragons.l5.Effect: Can only be knocked unconscious or have locations stop through magical means.

ability.mr.vessel-of-the-dragons.l6.Name: Immune to All but Magic
ability.mr.vessel-of-the-dragons.l6.Effect: Now completely immune to all except Magic.

ability.mr.winter-barbarian.l1.Name: Tribal Conversion
ability.mr.winter-barbarian.l1.Effect: Counts in all ways as Tribal from this point and may join only a Winter Barbarian tribe.

ability.mr.winter-barbarian.l1.2.Name: Human Life Scale by Class
ability.mr.winter-barbarian.l1.2.Effect: Life now as Human of same base class by level.

ability.mr.winter-barbarian.l2.Name: Cold Survival
ability.mr.winter-barbarian.l2.Effect: Gains Survival as Ranger in cold environments only.

ability.mr.winter-barbarian.l4.Name: Wall of Ice Innate
ability.mr.winter-barbarian.l4.Effect: Gains one innate Wall of Ice.

ability.mr.winter-barbarian.l5.Name: Cold Perception

ability.merged.immunity-to-dying-effects.Name: Immunity to Dying Effects
ability.merged.immunity-to-dying-effects.Effect: Immunity to all Dying Effects. Must have Immunity to Bless/Curse and Resistance to Avenging Spirit. This means that upon taking a dying effect and becoming aware of what it is they may, instead of taking the dying effect, choose to be unconscious for 5 minutes. It should be noted the choice must be made at the point of taking the dying effect, not after working out how much damage it might do.
